summary.text: Sarah Silva is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 53 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Silva was born in Vado, New Mexico, graduated from Gadsden High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of San Francisco in 2003.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved back to the Mesilla Valley in 2009 after finishing college and organizing in the Bay Area, and that she works as an organizer and runs a consulting business that trains and coaches community-oriented people and organizations.
She has served as a board member for the Native Land Institute.

In the same survey, Silva listed among her legislative accomplishments an update to the state's medical malpractice law, protections for children at the Children, Youth and Families Department, funding for recruiting and training public safety personnel, and an interstate compact for licensed social workers.
She also said she is passionate about expanding access to healthcare.
